findings.title: Elixir exact PostgreSQL display reconstruction rejects valid stored control text
findings.actual_trigger: Valid reason/profile containing U+000B U+000E U+000F or U+001A..U+001F
findings.observed: PostgreSQL renders lowercase hexadecimal in control-character escapes; Jason renders uppercase. Both typed decoders produce identical CBOR. SQL writes/replays these valid rows; Elixir validate_row! rejects actual retained rows.
findings.required_change: Independently implement exact selected PostgreSQL JSON string escaping for typed display/retained-row comparison. Preserve literal backslash-u text and case; do not broadly lowercase escape-like substrings or weaken byte equality. Preserve the existing failing assertions and all original positive/corruption tests. Fresh independent verification remains required.
